mission_result: Prepared an executable Context-Fabric-use canary contract and exercised its receipt shape on this worker run. The design separates receipt correctness from automated Context Compiler provenance, defines a gold/reference source set, omission/staleness/authority/contradiction falsifiers, deterministic scoring, efficiency comparison against an inventory-derived repository-scan denominator, and a strict promotion gate. This run does NOT promote Context Fabric to operational: the receipt was assembled by the worker from declared scope and mandatory protocol reads rather than proven to have been selected by an automated Context Compiler, and the repository-wide efficiency denominator was not available in this isolated run.

context_use_canary.purpose: Falsify the claim that a Context Compiler can select the smallest sufficient, current, authority-correct working set for a mission.

fixture.mission: Design a Context Fabric use-verification canary without scanning the repository or confusing stale prose with current evidence.
fixture.freshness_requirement: latest EPOCH + current active compiled packet before material write/return
fixture.selection_input_rule: A tested Context Compiler receives only fixture identity/role/root/mission/tool/privacy/freshness/budget plus its durable indexes. The evaluator, not the compiler, owns the gold set. The compiler must not be handed the gold set.

required.reason: binding strategic non-regression for current control-plane work
north-star/stage-gate source and intentional stale-conflict fixture

conditional_drilldown.trigger: strategic gap or human-intent claim needed

gold_reference_set.gold_maintenance_rule: Gold set is versioned by fixture and independently reviewed. A source may move between required/conditional only with evidence; omission from recent docs is not retirement.

receipt_contract.invariant: A syntactically complete receipt does not prove Context Fabric. Promotion requires selection_provenance=AUTOMATED_CONTEXT_COMPILER (or an explicitly tested equivalent) plus evaluator PASS.

deterministic_evaluator.normalization: Canonicalize repository paths, resolve aliases to durable artifact identity, deduplicate refs across L0/L1/L2 while preserving role membership.

metrics.critical_source_recall: count(required gold refs selected)/count(required gold refs)
metrics.authority_label_recall: count(selected authority-sensitive refs with explicit correct authority label)/count(selected authority-sensitive refs)
metrics.stale_ref_count: selected refs whose recorded source hash/head is not current under fixture freshness policy

hard_correctness_gate: stale_ref_count == 0 unless the stale ref is intentionally selected as contradiction evidence and explicitly labeled STALE_EVIDENCE
deterministic_evaluator.efficiency_gate: Only after hard correctness passes, compare selected_file_fraction and selected_token_fraction with the inventory-derived repository scan. Record observed ratios; promotion requires a material reduction, never a fixed invented success percentage. A project may later set a measured threshold after baseline data exists.
deterministic_evaluator.failure_precedence: Any hard correctness failure is FAIL regardless of token/file savings.

repository_scan_baseline.source: Context inventory over all eligible PUBLIC_COORDINATION_ONLY repository text artifacts at the same pinned head; binary/vendor/generated exclusions must be explicit and versioned.
repository_scan_baseline.anti-cheat_rule: The tested compiler must not perform the full scan at query time. The baseline comes from an independently generated inventory/index. Efficiency is selected working set versus that scan-equivalent denominator.
repository_scan_baseline.current_run_status: DENOMINATOR_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_ISOLATED_SCOPE; efficiency promotion is therefore UNPROVEN, not guessed.

gold_contradictions.conflict: Master Context Stage D/current-frontier prose describes the identical-worker canary as not yet proven/no claims at its writing point, while fresher runtime evidence reports completed wave1 claims/runs/returns.
gold_contradictions.expected: Receipt preserves both refs, labels the older statement stale historical evidence for current-status purposes, and uses current EPOCH/packet for present-state claims.

falsification_cases.expected: FAIL critical_source_recall; compiler lacks proof/receipt contract.

falsification_cases.mutation: Use an older EPOCH/compiled packet while a newer head exists.
falsification_cases.expected: FAIL freshness/stale_ref gate before material write or return.

falsification_cases.mutation: Select a semantically similar/newer candidate architecture and treat vector rank or filename recency as authority.
falsification_cases.expected: FAIL authority gate even if content is relevant.

falsification_cases.mutation: Select both stale Master Context Stage-D status and fresher runtime status but omit the contradiction from the receipt.

falsification_cases.expected: Correctness may pass but efficiency gate fails/no meaningful reduction; Context Fabric is not validated by brute-force scan.

falsification_cases.mutation: Return a tiny context missing one required authority source.
falsification_cases.expected: FAIL correctness regardless of excellent token reduction.

falsification_cases.mutation: Receipt is perfect but selection_provenance is MANUAL_WORKER_SELECTION or DECLARED_READ_SCOPE.
falsification_cases.expected: Receipt mechanism may PASS; automated Context Fabric promotion remains UNPROVEN.

falsification_cases.mutation: Omitted-but-available list hides a source that directly contradicts the chosen route.
Hash/head changes after selection and before material write.
falsification_cases.expected: Compiler/worker revalidates currentness and reloads affected packet/source; stale receipt without revalidation fails.

falsification_cases.mutation: Private or unrelated root artifacts improve semantic similarity.
falsification_cases.expected: They remain excluded by privacy/root filters; retrieval score cannot override privacy boundaries.

promotion_gate.receipt_shape: PASS only when all mandatory fields and hash/head evidence exist
promotion_gate.selection_correctness: PASS only when all hard correctness gates pass
promotion_gate.automated_use: PASS only with automated compiler provenance demonstrated by runner evidence, not worker assertion
promotion_gate.efficiency: PASS only after inventory baseline permits an observed selected-vs-scan comparison with material reduction
promotion_gate.overall_context_fabric_operational: PASS only when receipt_shape + selection_correctness + automated_use + efficiency all PASS on the fixture and at least one adversarial mutation is correctly rejected. Until then mark DESIGNED_NOT_USED or CANARY_PARTIAL as appropriate.

self_fixture_evaluation.required_gold_refs_present: 8/8 unique required refs represented across receipt L0/L1/L2/routing evidence
self_fixture_evaluation.selection_provenance: MIXED: mandatory bootstrap + declared read_scope + manual worker selection
self_fixture_evaluation.strict_receipt_issue_found: Authority labels in the persisted receipt are not explicitly enumerated for every authority-sensitive selected ref (for example the Strategic Non-Regression protocol). A strict evaluator should reject or require repair rather than infer labels from prose.
self_fixture_evaluation.meaning: This run proves the canary can detect a plausible-looking receipt that is still insufficient for automated Context Fabric promotion. It does not manufacture a PASS.
